items.title: Finite projective modules over the fibre product of rings correspond to matching pairs of finite projective modules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the category of finite projective modules over the fibre product of two rings with the category of triples of a finite projective module over one factor, a finite projective module over the other, and an isomorphism after base change. The proof reduces finite projectivity to finite presentation plus flatness, uses the earlier flatness and finiteness results to reduce to showing that the fibre product module is finitely presented, then chooses a surjection from a finite free module, compares the kernel with the fibre product of the kernels obtained after base change, verifies that the comparison map is an isomorphism, and concludes finite generation of the kernel from the exactness of the two sequences after tensoring, which is exactly where flatness of the two given modules is used.
